profile.name: Jordan Rivers
profile.tagline: Designing interactive storytelling systems that travel across every platform.
profile.summary: Curious, human-centered technologist crafting narrative-driven products for web, conversational AI, and live events.
focus: Designing adaptive story flows for Gemini
Hosting an open archive for public readers
prompts: How did today's experiment change the way you tell this story?
What would a first-time visitor remember from this chapter?
Which collaborator helped illuminate the theme today?

timeline.title: First interactive memoir prototype
timeline.description: Sketched a branching narrative using index cards and short audio clips. Learned how nonlinear storytelling opens empathy.

timeline.title: Open-sourced interactive timeline
timeline.description: Released a toolkit for crafting personal history websites. Collaborated with volunteers to translate it into five languages.

timeline.title: Railway deployment pipeline
timeline.description: Automated environment provisioning, preview URLs, and scheduled backups so storytellers can focus on craft, not infrastructure.

timeline.title: Gemini narrative experiments
timeline.description: Worked with multimodal prompts, dynamic tone adjustments, and voice staging to build living autobiographies with Gemini.

timeline.title: Public launch of interactive autobiography
timeline.description: Unified the Gemini conversational experience with a polished web destination and Railway-backed automation.

achievements.title: Storyworld festival keynote
achievements.description: Shared lessons on bringing machine learning empathy into autobiographical design.
details: Built a live demo that reacted to audience prompts
Published resources for educators and community leaders
Raised funding for an inclusive story lab

achievements.title: Railway automation suite
achievements.description: Packaged infrastructure tooling so smaller teams could host narratives with confidence.
details: Provisioned safe staging and production parity
Documented incident playbooks with lived examples

achievements.title: Community story fellowship
achievements.description: Mentored eight creators to publish interactive autobiographies in their own languages.
details: Held weekly critique sessions with global guests
Launched shared asset libraries for reuse
